summary: Commissions module — Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (100%) covering all 7 endpoints (settings GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, earned GET, dashboard, pay, report-pdf) plus auto-calc hook on POST /clinic/sales. Validated 4 enum/required validations (applies_to=BOGUS→400, calculation_type=BOGUS→400, applies_to=service without service_id→400, applies_to=product without product_id→400), end-to-end auto-calc flow (rule 30% all_consultations + sale Q500 with doctor_id → commissions_earned row base=500 commission=150 status=earned, sale WITHOUT doctor_id → no commission row), dashboard totals (total_earned/paid/pending + by_doctor with base_total/earned_total/paid_total/pending_total/count/doctor_name), bulk pay (single id paid → status=paid + paid_at + payment_reference; double-pay returns 400 'Ninguna comisión elegible'; empty ids → 400), PUT toggle is_active, DELETE rule (clinic_admin OK), and PDF report generation (signed URL returned + content-type application/pdf verified by fetching). Frontend: full E2E via Playwright — login → /dashboard/comisiones renders with feature flag 'commissions' enabled, sidebar 'Comisiones' (Percent icon) navigates correctly. Liquidación tab cards display correct values (Total generado Q300.00 / Pagadas Q300.00 / Pendientes Q0.00 from backend dashboard endpoint). Reglas tab loads with 'Nueva regla' button. New Rule dialog opens with all required form controls (rule-doctor-select, rule-applies-select, rule-calc-select, rule-percentage-input). PDF export button rendered. No frontend errors in console.

minor.issue: N+1: per-row clinic_members + sales + sale_items lookups (lines 5253-5264). For pages with 50 commissions ≥150 extra queries per page hit. Recommend a single PostgREST select with embedded relations (e.g., select('*,sale:sales(sale_number,customer_name),item:sale_items(description),doctor:clinic_members(first_name,last_name))').
Per-doctor enrichment loop also issues one members query per doctor (line 5305). Same N+1 pattern; aggregate name lookup with a single .in_('id', list_of_doctor_ids).execute().
Same N+1 enrichment (lines 5371-5381) — for PDFs spanning many sale_items this becomes O(N).

Helper is synchronous but called from async create_sale; under load it will block the event loop on Supabase HTTP I/O. Since it is best-effort post-commit, consider running in BackgroundTasks or asyncio.to_thread.
No upper-bound check on percentage (>100 accepted). Trivial but allows nonsensical 200% rules.

No uniqueness/dedup logic — admin can create N identical 'all_consultations' rules for the same doctor and the helper just picks the first match found by Python list iteration order (no created_at sort). Small risk of non-deterministic rule selection if duplicates are seeded.

issues: Native <input type='date'> used for Desde/Hasta — recurring across modules; should use shadcn Calendar popover for consistency.
Loading spinner blocks the by_doctor table rendering even when the cards already have data; the table should show a skeleton row instead so users can see structure while loading.

Two DialogContent components emit 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' warnings (doctor-drill-dialog and rule-form-dialog) — accessibility issue. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby={undefined}.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~5460 lines and growing — commissions adds another 380 lines. Strongly recommend extracting routers per resource (sales, ar, expenses, inventory, agenda, commissions). Same recurring feedback as iterations 14-15.

_compute_commissions_for_sale priority logic uses list-iteration order; if multiple 'all_consultations' rules exist for same doctor (admin error), first one wins non-deterministically. Sort by created_at desc or enforce DB unique partial index.
POST /clinic/commissions/settings does not validate that doctor_id actually maps to a clinic_member with role='doctor' in this clinic — admin could mistakenly bind rule to a non-doctor member.
Fixed-amount rule multiplies by quantity (line 5221) — correct for unit-based items. Worth documenting in API spec.
Hard-delete on /commissions/settings — no soft-delete or audit log. For accounting traceability consider archived_at flag like recommended for /expenses.
